{{Quote|Help, help, you must aid me. Oh please, good citizen, my master is in dire need of assistance.|MT-D6, to one of the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian}}</ref>}}
'''MT-D6''' was an [[MT-D messenger droid]] that was owned by the [[Cularin Office of Public Safety]] agent [[Ezra Du'Re]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], MT-D6 accompanied Du'Re on a mission to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where Du'Re was investigating the theft of a number of high-value art objects. However, Du'Re was attacked while inside a Tolea Biqua warehouse, and MT-D6 fled, hoping to find some reinforcements to assist his master. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] encountered the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]], and at his request, the agents traveled to the warehouse to aid Du'Re.
